note: Grade F is automatic: red-teamer confirmed breach of a critical business objective (RED-002: unauthenticated force-approve overrides 3-deny AI governance consensus). Operator decision required before any merge.

findings.title: Complete Authentication Absence — All API Endpoints Publicly Accessible
findings.remediation: Add JWT Bearer or API-key middleware as the first middleware in Source/Backend/src/app.ts and portal/Backend/src/index.ts before all route handlers. Install jsonwebtoken, bcrypt. Separate public health endpoints from protected API routes.
findings.evidence: GET /api/feature-requests → HTTP 200, no auth. POST /api/bugs → HTTP 201, no auth. GET /metrics → full Prometheus data, Node.js v22.23.0 fingerprinted.

findings.title: Force-Approve Overrides AI Governance Consensus (3–2 Deny Majority Bypassed) [F-TRIGGER]
findings.remediation: Gate force-approve and overrideRoute:fast-track behind an authenticated privileged human-operator role. Require audit reason. Log the overriding principal's identity. Consider 2FA for force-override actions.
findings.evidence: FR-0001 created → AI voted 3 deny / 2 approve → POST /force-approve with empty body, no auth → HTTP 200, status approved. Entire AI governance layer negated in one unauthenticated HTTP call.

findings.title: Webhook Intake Lacks HMAC Signature Verification — Arbitrary Pipeline Injection
findings.remediation: Verify X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature (HMAC-SHA256) against a shared secret from env before processing. Apply shared secret token for automated endpoint. Add strict enum validation on type and priority fields.
findings.evidence: POST /api/intake/zendesk accepts any body with title+description, no HMAC check. type field stored without enum validation.

findings.title: Permanent Dispatch Sabotage via Soft-Deleted Blocker (Dependency DoS)
findings.remediation: In computeHasUnresolvedBlockers(), treat status:'unknown' (soft-deleted) as resolved, not blocking. Cascade-delete or nullify dependency links when a blocker is deleted. Add auth to DELETE and dependency endpoints.
findings.evidence: FR-0027 permanently blocked with has_unresolved_blockers:true after blocker FR-0028 soft-deleted. Ghost reference {title:'Unknown',status:'unknown'} persists. No API path to recover.

findings.title: Mass Data Enumeration — Pagination Completely Unenforced
findings.remediation: Enforce server-side pagination: const limit = Math.min(parseInt(req.query.limit,10)||20, 100). Apply to all list endpoints including /dashboard/queue. Return {data,total,page,limit,totalPages} envelope.
findings.evidence: ?limit=1 silently ignored, all 26 items returned. GET /api/dashboard/queue returns all items grouped, no pagination param accepted.

findings.title: Audit Trail XSS Injection — 5,116-char Script Payload Stored Verbatim
findings.remediation: Enforce max comment length (2,000 chars). Output-encode all audit fields at render time. Store authenticated user identity alongside comment. Do not use dangerouslySetInnerHTML on any audit field.
findings.evidence: 5,116-char payload including <script>alert(1)</script> and fake admin metadata stored verbatim in human_approval_comment via unauthenticated /deny.

findings.title: Prometheus /metrics Endpoint Unauthenticated — System Fingerprinting
findings.remediation: Restrict /metrics to internal observability stack via firewall/ingress rules, or add bearer-token middleware. At minimum strip nodejs_version_info from public output.
findings.evidence: GET /metrics → nodejs_version_info{version='v22.23.0'}, 134MB RSS, event-loop lag, FD count, operational counters. Zero auth required.

findings.title: Cascade Auto-Dispatch Triggered by Unauthenticated Rejection
findings.remediation: Require authentication before any rejection. Remove REJECTED from DISPATCH_TRIGGER_STATUSES or add explicit human-confirmation step before cascade dispatch fires.

findings.title: File Upload Trusts Client-Supplied MIME Type — Stored XSS (Portal Backend)
findings.remediation: Use file-type or magic-bytes library to verify actual file content. Normalize extension to verified type. Serve uploads from separate origin or with Content-Disposition: attachment and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

findings.title: Docker Socket Mounted Inside Orchestrator Container — Host Escape Risk
findings.remediation: Use Docker-in-Docker with rootless daemon, or restrict socket access via authorization plugins. Move credentials to secrets manager. Scope: platform/ (solo-session only per CLAUDE.md).

findings.title: No Authorization / RBAC — All Privileged Operations Unauthenticated
findings.remediation: Define roles (viewer, operator, admin). Attach role middleware to each route group. Gate all state-transition and override endpoints behind operator or admin role.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting — DoS and Brute-Force Attacks Unmitigated
findings.remediation: Add express-rate-limit with tiered limits: 100 req/min general, 10 req/min for state-transition endpoints, stricter for intake webhooks.

findings.title: No TLS / HTTPS Enforcement
findings.remediation: Terminate TLS at ingress/reverse-proxy (nginx, Caddy, AWS ALB). Enforce HSTS. Add helmet.hsts() to both apps.

findings.title: Missing Required Audit Events: login_attempt and permission_denied
findings.remediation: After adding auth middleware, emit structured log events for every authentication attempt and every authorization denial. Include principal identity, timestamp, IP, and resource path.

findings.title: Search Endpoint Returns Full Corpus on Empty or Missing Query
findings.remediation: Require non-empty q parameter (min 2 chars). Apply pagination enforcement. Add auth before returning search results.

findings.title: No HTTP Security Headers (Helmet Missing) on Either Service
findings.remediation: Add helmet() as first middleware in both apps. Minimum: helmet({ contentSecurityPolicy: true, xFrameOptions: { action: 'deny' }, xContentTypeOptions: true, hsts: { maxAge: 31536000 } }).

findings.title: Internal Orchestrator URL Leaked in HTTP 502 Response Body
findings.remediation: Return generic 'Service temporarily unavailable' in 502 response. Log URL internally only.

findings.title: Source/Backend Has No CORS Policy — Cross-Origin Requests Permitted
findings.remediation: Add cors({ origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(',') ?? ['http://localhost:5173'], credentials: true }) before all route handlers. Mirror the pattern already in portal/Backend.

findings.title: Orchestrator Proxy Forwards Unvalidated Client-Controlled URL (SSRF Risk)
findings.remediation: Define allowlist of permitted forwarded path prefixes. Reject any req.url that does not match the allowlist with 403.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest — Sensitive Data in Plaintext In-Memory Store
findings.remediation: Migrate to persistent encrypted store. Encrypt sensitive fields at rest.

findings.title: Incomplete Audit Event: state_transition (Partial Logging Only)
findings.remediation: Emit structured events for every status transition with principal, timestamp, and from/to states.

findings.title: Missing Audit Event: data_export
findings.remediation: Emit data_export event on any bulk-list or search response. Include requester identity and record count.

findings.title: No Permanent Data Deletion (GDPR Article 17 — Right to Erasure)
findings.remediation: Add hard-delete endpoint gated behind admin role. Purge all associated records including change history and dependency links.

findings.title: NaN/Infinity Injection via Pagination Parameters
findings.remediation: Validate page and limit with Number.isFinite() before use. Return 400 on invalid values. Handle limit=0 case (totalPages → Infinity) explicitly.

findings.title: overrideRoute Field Accepts Invalid Enum Values — Data Corruption
findings.remediation: Add runtime enum validation: reject any overrideRoute value not in Object.values(WorkItemRoute) with 400.

findings.title: No Input Length Limits or Body Size Caps on Free-Text Fields
findings.remediation: Enforce title <= 200 and description <= 10000 chars. Add express.json({ limit: '100kb' }) to both apps.

findings.title: Math.random() Used in Business-Logic Simulation (Non-Cryptographic RNG)
findings.remediation: Substitute crypto.randomFloat() (Node 20+) or crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0] / 0xFFFFFFFF. Injectable RNG pattern already makes this easy to swap.

passing_controls: OWASP-ASVS V13.3 — State machine enforcement (confirmed by RED-009)
OWASP-ASVS V14.5.2 — CORS on portal/Backend (confirmed by RED-008)
